_source: SIMULATION for scripts/demo/blueprint-timelapse.mjs. One sample person: the portal sample client in src/demo/client-portal-sample-bundle.json ('Portal Sample', Sample Consulting LLC, Plaid sandbox bank v3) and the one credit file src/finance/sample-credit-file.mjs builds from that bundle's Personal Visa (limit $8,000, balance $3,127 on 2026-10-17; one old 30-day late on a closed Toyota loan; three hard inquiries). Simulated here: the dates, the Visa balance at each monthly pull after Day 0, the client's clicks, uploads and replies, which server-owned question the coach chooses, and the coach call's words. The person already runs an LLC with business checking and a Business Amex (bundle facts), so the LLC / EIN / business checking steps are ticked in week 1 as already done. No coach text exists on Day 0 in shipped code: the first coach message is the reminder ladder on the paydown due date.
